text:
Hana: heads up — I sketched a prototype 'Route Healthboard' heatmap for Console. It shows p50/p95/p99 token latency, throughput and error rate by route and kernel variant. sharing profiling notes and a couple regressions we saw.

Kevin: love the idea. can you paste the profiling snippet? curious if p99 aligns with KV cache misses or batching fallback.

Hana: paste below — short summary: traffic spike -> more small batches -> kernel fallback to generic path -> KV cache miss rate up -> p99 token latency jumps ~4x for a couple routes.

Hana: ```
# sampled profile (route /chat/stream)
kernel_version: kv-opt-v2
batch_size: 1..8
avg_input_len: 24
kv_cache_hit: 82.3%
kv_fetch_latency_p95_ms: 18
token_latency_p99_ms: 420
fallback_kernel_count: 14%
```

Maya: interesting. fallback_kernel_count at 14% is high. could be kernel selection heuristic not considering sequence length distribution. do we surface kernel selection as a metric? we should.

Sam: we currently emit a gauge: runtime_kernel.name and increment when a kernel is used, but it lives at pod level. that's high-cardinality and hard to chart per-route.

Loren: proposal: emit summarized counters per route+kernel combo with labels: route, model_family, kernel_type, batch_bucket, kv_hit_bucket. low-cardinality buckets only. sample topology could be: batch_bucket={1,2-4,5-8,9+}, kv_hit_bucket={<50,50-90,>90}.

Hana: agree. also add token-level waterfall histograms: server_preprocess_ms, kv_lookup_ms, kernel_exec_ms, serialize_ms. We can derive token_latency = sum(components). these should be histograms so we can compute p50/p95/p99 and show stacked breakdowns.

Kevin: histograms good. but we must be careful with cardinality. recommend rollups at 1m and 5m. For Console, heatmap cells should query 1m p95 of token_latency and color by regression compared to baseline.

Sam: incremental approach: 1) expose component histograms on a sampled subset of requests (1-5%), 2) export aggregated per-route per-minute summaries (counts, p50/p95/p99) to metrics store, 3) Console queries summaries for heatmap.

Maya: sampling helps cost. but for incident investigations we need full traces occasionally. add a trigger to capture full token waterfalls for routes crossing a p99 threshold and store to tracing backend.

Hana: exactly. add a boolean route flag to enable full-capture on canary routes. also want KV miss tracer: when kv_fetch_latency > 20ms, emit an event with route, key_prefix, model_shard.

Loren: dashboard UX notes: heatmap by route on y-axis, time on x-axis, cells show p95 token latency. clicking a cell opens drilldown: breakdown by kernel_type, distribution histograms, kv_hit_rate, batch_size_hist. include small sparkline for throughput and error rate.

Sam: metric names sketch (Prom-style):
- redwood_route_token_latency_bucket{route="/chat/stream",kernel="kv-opt-v2",le="..."}
- redwood_route_token_latency_sum{...}
- redwood_route_token_latency_count{...}
- redwood_route_kv_hit_ratio{route="...",bucket="90-100"}
- redwood_route_kernel_fallback_ratio{...}
- redwood_route_batch_bucket_count{...}

Hana: +1. also include labels for deployment_stage (prod/canary) and region. for dedicated customers, route should include tenant id (hashed) to avoid PII.

Kevin: alert rules draft:
- route.p95_token_latency > baseline_p95 * 2 for 3 consecutive minutes -> Sev2
- route.kv_hit_ratio drops > 15% absolute -> page on route-critical
- kernel_fallback_ratio > 10% and p99 increase -> auto-open perf-incident with traces

Maya: for baseline_p95 we can use 7d rolling median per route and kernel. store this as a derived metric so Console can show delta %.

Loren: UI: a 'regression' overlay on heatmap cell: red if delta>+50%, amber if +20..50%, green otherwise. hover shows numeric p50/p95/p99 and delta%. include a 'compare to' selector (last week, baseline, custom range).

Sam: ops-bot integration: when a cell triggers auto-incident, ops-bot posts to #incidents with step link to open traces and a short perf summary. cc: ci-bot to tag recent deploys affecting the route.

ops-bot: auto-incident template: "[PERF] route=/chat/stream region=us-east p95=420ms (+160%) baseline=160ms kernel=generic_v1 kv_hit=69%". attach link to trace and last deploy commit.

Hana: next action items:
- Sam: instrument route-level component histograms with sampling and per-minute rollups (ETA 4d)
- Loren: mockups for heatmap + drilldown (ETA 3d)
- Maya: alert rule prototypes and baseline calculation (ETA 2d)
- Kevin: add kernel selection telemetry (low-card buckets) and fallback counters (ETA 3d)

Kevin: quick Q — should histogram buckets be token-ms focused (e.g., 1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256,512) to capture token tail? probably yes.

Hana: yes, use exponential ms buckets. also add counters for token_counts per request and sample a few full-request traces.

Maya: noted. I can draft alert docs and thresholds. will sync tomorrow AM.

Loren: will upload initial mockups to Figma and post link here when ready.

Sam: starting a spike branch now. will push proto metrics export and a demo grafana dashboard for quick iteration.

Hana: thanks everyone. let's aim to have a Console heatmap MVP behind a feature flag in 2 sprints. :thumbsup:

Kevin: :rocket:

ci-bot: deploy queued for perf-spike-proto -> staging
